steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The marketing mix (4Ps) combines Product, Price, Place, and Promotion into a coherent strategy. All elements must be consistent - a premium product at a budget price with limited availability and cheap advertising creates confusion. | Key Fact: Product: what is being sold, including features, quality, design, branding, packaging, and after-sales service. It must meet customer needs and be differentiated from competitors. | Key Fact: Price: must reflect the product's positioning and target market's willingness to pay. Premium products need premium prices; budget products need competitive prices. Pricing must also cover costs and generate profit. | Key Fact: Place: how and where the product is sold.
